target: end of Q2 FY21 (Nov 2020)
first_quote: our top priority is to normalize inventory by the end of the second quarter
outcome: Achieved on time per Q2 FY21 call.

target: FY22 revenue growth low double digits, above $50B
first_quote: In Fiscal 22, we expect Revenue to grow low double-digits and surpass $50 billion
outcome: FY22 revenue $46,710M, +5% (FY22 10-K p. 56). Cut was blamed on Vietnam factory closures.

target: FY22 gross margin +125 to 150 bp
first_quote: We expect Gross Margin to expand 125 to 150 basis points
outcome: FY22 gross margin 46.0% vs 44.8%, +120 bp (FY22 10-K p. 31; FY21 10-K p. 31): below the raised 'at least 150 bp'.

target: FY22 to FY25 revenue growth high single to low double digits on average
first_quote: we expect Revenue growth to inflect upwards to a range of high single digit to low double digit growth on average
outcome: FY21 to FY25 revenue CAGR +1.0% ($44,538M to $46,309M; FY21 10-K p. 57, FY25 10-K p. 32; my arithmetic).

target: gross margin in the high 40s by FY25
first_quote: We now see Gross Margin rate reaching the high 40s by fiscal 25
outcome: FY25 gross margin 42.7% (FY25 10-K p. 32).

target: EBIT margin high teens by FY25
first_quote: we see our EBIT margin reaching high-teens by fiscal 25
outcome: FY25 EBIT margin 8.2% (Q4 FY25 release p. 6).

target: Greater China low-to-mid-teens growth over the long term
first_quote: we are optimistic that we can continue to grow low-to-mid-teens over the long-term
outcome: Greater China revenue $8,290M (FY21) to $5,847M (FY26), about -7% a year (FY21 10-K p. 36, FY26 10-K p. 36; my arithmetic).

target: FY23 gross margin flat to -50 bp
first_quote: We expect gross margins to be in the range of flat to declining by 50 basis points versus the prior year
outcome: FY23 gross margin 43.5% vs 46.0%, -250 bp (FY23 10-K p. 31).

target: FY23 revenue growth low double digits currency-neutral
first_quote: We expect Revenue for the full year to grow low double-digits on a currency-neutral basis
outcome: FY23 currency-neutral revenue +16% (Q4 FY23 release p. 4).

target: healthy pull market by end of Q2 FY23 (Nov 2022)
first_quote: our focus is on getting to a healthy pull market by the end of the second quarter
outcome: Reached about two quarters late (end of FY23 instead of end of Q2 FY23).

target: FY24 revenue growth mid single digits
first_quote: For the full year we expect Fiscal '24 reported revenue to grow mid-single digits, led by Nike Direct

target: FY24 gross margin +140 to 160 bp
first_quote: We expect gross margins to expand 140 to 160 basis points on a reported basis
outcome: FY24 gross margin 44.6% vs 43.5%, +110 bp (FY24 10-K p. 33).

target: FY25 revenue and earnings growth, margins expanding
first_quote: We expect revenue and earnings to grow versus the prior year, with operating margins expanding
outcome: FY25 revenue -10% (Q4 FY25 release p. 1); diluted EPS $2.16 vs $3.73 (FY25 10-K p. 56; FY24 10-K p. 57); EBIT margin 8.2% vs 12.7%.

target: Investor Day with 5-year algorithm, late 2024
first_quote: And we look forward to sharing our plans in-depth at an Investor Day later this year
outcome: Postponed about two years; now scheduled Nov 16 to 17, 2026.

target: Q4 FY25 is the worst quarter; headwinds moderate after
first_quote: we believe that the fourth quarter will reflect the largest impact from our Win Now actions, and that the headwinds to revenue and gross margin will begin to moderate from there
outcome: Q4 FY25 revenue -12%, gross margin -440 bp; then Q1 FY26 +1%/-320 bp, Q2 FY26 +1%/-300 bp, Q3 FY26 0%/-130 bp (10-Qs and releases; my arithmetic).

target: healthy and clean marketplace by end of 1H FY26 (Nov 2025)
first_quote: We expect these actions will continue through the first half of Fiscal 2026
outcome: Declared done for North America and EMEA in Dec 2025, reversed for EMEA three months later and for North America sportswear in Oct 2026; supply cuts now run into FY28.

target: Win Now actions finished by end of calendar 2026
first_quote: By the end of the calendar year, we expect to have finished our Win Now actions
outcome: 'Win Now' is not mentioned once in the Q1 FY27 call (0 vs 16 to 24 mentions a call before); replaced by the Pace program with savings mostly in FY29 to FY30.

target: wholesale returns to modest growth in FY26
first_quote: we expect wholesale revenue to return to modest growth for fiscal '26
outcome: FY26 wholesale $27,453M vs $25,883M, +6.1% (FY26 10-K p. 32; FY25 10-K p. 33; my arithmetic).

target: NIKE Direct does not return to growth in FY26
first_quote: we do not expect NIKE Direct to return to growth for fiscal '26

target: Q4 FY26 to Q2 FY27 revenue down low single digits
first_quote: We expect revenues to be down low single digits versus the prior year with gains in North America offset by declines in Greater China
outcome: Q4 FY26 -1%, Q1 FY27 -4% so far; window cut once, then full-year FY27 set at a high single digit decline, which implies a weaker second half.

target: gross margin expansion from Q2 FY27
first_quote: We expect gross margin expansion to begin in the second quarter
outcome: Q1 FY27 gross margin 42.8% vs 42.2%, +60 bp (Q1 FY27 10-Q p. 22). FY27 gross margin no longer guided.

target: earnings flattish Q4 FY26 to Q2 FY27
first_quote: We expect earnings to be flattish with gross margins beginning to inflect
outcome: Q1 FY27 diluted EPS $0.48 vs $0.49 (Q1 FY27 10-Q p. 1); Q2 FY27 reported about Dec 17, 2026.

target: Q1 FY27 last quarter of material tariff headwind
first_quote: we expect the first quarter of fiscal '27 to be the final quarter where higher tariffs continue to be a material year-over-year headwind to gross margin
outcome: The word 'tariff' does not appear in the Q1 FY27 call; Q1 gross margin rose 60 bp.

target: restructuring benefits start FY27 and build through FY28
first_quote: We expect benefits from these actions to begin in fiscal '27 and continue to build through fiscal '28
outcome: The new Pace program puts most of its $2.5B savings in FY29 to FY30; the FY27 to FY28 benefit language was not repeated.

target: return to double-digit EBIT margins (no date)
first_quote: And over time, we absolutely have the ambition to get back to double-digit operating margins
outcome: Never dated in six calls. FY26 EBIT margin 8.3% (FY26 10-K p. 31); FY27 guided lower.

target: classics down more than $4B from peak by end of FY26
first_quote: The Classics footwear franchises are on track to decline from peak levels by more than $4 billion by fiscal year-end
outcome: Management-reported; not separately disclosed in filings.

target: China recovery (never dated)
first_quote: China will take longer due to the unique characteristics of the marketplace
outcome: Greater China revenue $1,180M in Q1 FY27, -22% vs $1,512M (Q1 FY27 10-Q p. 25; Q1 FY26 release p. 4; my arithmetic). No recovery date has ever been given.
